description: This file contains unit tests for parsing logs in the 'logs' module, with a focus on verifying the correct extraction of log lines from various input scenarios.

classes.name: logs.LogLine
classes.description: Represents a parsed log line containing timestamp, thread IDs, log level, tag, and message.

classes.name: ps.ProcessSet
classes.description: A collection class for process-related information used during log parsing.

methods.name: test_empty()
methods.description: Tests parsing an empty log message with no content.

methods.name: test_none()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with no tag and no message.

methods.name: test_trailing_blank()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with an extra newline at the end.

methods.name: test_blank_between()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with blank lines in the message.

methods.name: test_preceeding_blank()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with a blank line before message content.

methods.name: test_one_blank()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with a single blank line message.

methods.name: test_two_blanks()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with two blank lines.

methods.name: test_two_lines_noblanks()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with two lines of message with no blank lines.

methods.name: test_chatty()
methods.description: Tests parsing a log with multiple identical messages to check for chatty message handling.

methods.name: test_normal()
methods.description: Tests parsing a realistic short log with multiple messages.

methods.name: check_parsing(expected, text)
methods.description: Utility function to compare parsed output against expected results.
